title: Bitcoin is now 56.7% green: Here’s how it could get even cleaner
summary: Bitcoin mining is accelerating renewable energy deployment, replacing fossil-fuel heating, expanding energy access and cutting methane emissions at scale.

title: Zcash devs unveil ‘cashZ’ wallet after exiting Electric Coin Co
summary: Employees who left the Electric Coin Company en masse on Wednesday are launching a new Zcash wallet, citing the need to return to cypherpunk principles and to scale faster.

title: Optimism floats OP buyback proposal using Superchain revenue
summary: A new plan would tie OP token value to network performance by using half of all Superchain fee revenue for systematic repurchases.

title: Global sanctions fuel record flow to illicit crypto addresses
summary: The Global Sanctions Inflation Index estimated there were just under 80,000 total sanctioned entities and persons globally as of May 2025.

title: Bitcoin to hit $2.9M by 2050 as it muscles into global trade: VanEck
summary: VanEck analysts said Bitcoin could handle 5–10% of global trade and make up 2.5% of central bank reserves by 2050, driving its strategic role as a monetary hedge.

title: Coinbase lands 2nd ‘buy’ rating in a week, with BofA seeing 38% upside
summary: Bank of America has upgraded Coinbase's rating on reversing short interest and tax-loss harvesting, while the exchange is broadening its vision to put the financial system onchain.

title: Revived NY bill targets sports, politics and death prediction markets
summary: New York lawmakers will soon review a bill that seeks to ban certain sports and political event contracts in the state, among others.

title: Nexo to offer zero-interest crypto lending for BTC and ETH holders
summary: The offering expands Nexo’s structured lending products to Bitcoin and Ether holders amid a broader recovery in crypto-backed lending.

title: CFTC issues no-action letter to Bitnomial, clearing way for event contracts
summary: The no-action letter comes amid growing acceptance by US regulators of prediction-style markets and event contracts during an election year.

title: Donald Trump will not consider pardon for Sam Bankman-Fried: NYT
summary: The US president reportedly said he had no intention of pardoning the former FTX CEO, and defended his family’s connections to the crypto industry.
